name: twelve-region-probe
description: TEST ONLY. Camera probe of the 12-region hue, saturation and lightness stage (builder 0x7E56E186): each ART entry's film code gets its own 12-region table through the hash 0x7E78C6E4 (empty slots only), tables written over the stock tables of the descriptors that the chosen cases return (byte copies of table A / B, and the stock Key Line still table: scene modes and stock Key Line use the probe tables in this build); ART 12's film code takes Cross Process I's look curve. Data edits only, no code. Needs films-look-exif-artbkt before it (the look entry of code 159 is stock-films-structure-2's). See experiments/2026-11-20-twelve-region/NOTES.md.
